profile.headline: Snack-Loving Software Engineer at Apple Inc.
profile.summary:
Software Engineer working for Apple Maps.

Personal interests include working on iOS projects, helping others understand and better utilize technology, and making a difference one line of code at a time.

Passion for tinkering in iOS development, and have successfully made an app for the non-profit fishing organization Kokanee Power to help them better connect with their organization. The app is now available on the App Store.

If you’d like to learn more about how my skills can help your company, please reach out via email: (rachelsworld@gmail.com).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cartography Engineering, Maps
Software Engineer - Cartography Engineering, Maps
positions.description: o	Develop & Maintain tools for Designers and Cartographers to design the map using Objective C, C++ and Swift.

positions.title: Triage Engineer - Maps
positions.description:
o	Screened incoming Maps Client bugs.
o	Reproduced issues and assigned to relevant engineers.
o	Created webpage for viewing relevant bug counts & metrics for Maps Client team.

positions.title: Coordinator - Residential Computer Consultants
positions.description:
o	Promoted from consultant to coordinator in charge of ten on-site residential computer consultants.
o	Hired, trained and managed the students throughout the school year.

positions.title: Academic Software Developer
positions.description:
o Worked with Academic Technology Services to collaborate on academic technology projects. 
o Maintained Cel.ly and Custom Course Menu plugin for Moodle, working to open source the Cel.ly plugin using PHP, HTML, CSS and SQL.
o Use Git to share and maintain all work for plugins.

positions.title: Assistive Technology Assistant
positions.description:
o Reviewed school video library for closed caption needs.
o Added closed captioning to prominent school videos using Camtasia on a Mac Pro.
o Performed closed captioning sync checks across video library to ensure quality.
o Analyzed University podcasts on request via iTunes and created transcripts to improve accessibility.

positions.title: ND Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
o	Worked in a cross-platform environment using C#, Xamarin and 3rd party libraries as needed.
o	Coded forward engineering tasks for an app that communicates with a custom motion sensing device.
o	Developed specific code and processes for features such as internationalization, user preferences, analytics, crash reporting, audio feedback and video editing.

positions.title: Municipality Intern
positions.description:
-Assisted with creating educational tools for children receiving help with educational development in two different local health clinics.
-Observed operating strategies, and offered suggestions for improvement and solutions to technical problems in a presentation to the executives of the municipality.

projects.title: Kokanee Power iOS App
projects.description:
Designed an iOS App in Swift for the non-profit fishing organization Kokanee Power, now available for download on the App Store for iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch. 

The app includes information about the organization, an interactive map with fish plant information and a news feed with current articles and information. It also includes information and links for upcoming derbies as well as past derby results.

Currently working on making improvements in efficiency of data retrieval and updating the overall design.

projects.title: Senior Capstone Project - Envelopost
projects.description:
-Working with a UP E-scholar student to create an iOS application and e-commerce website for her Envelopost greeting card company. 
-Lead team of 5 for fall semester through design and began implementation of product for Envelopost client.
-Researched and coded features for iOS app using Swift such as app layout, menu, and appropriate AWS plugins.
